summary.intent: Continue executing phase 70.1's wave-based plan rollout for CipherBox: verify a prior commit landed despite a tool timeout, close out Wave 4, and dispatch Wave 5 (plan 11, FUSE gate-correctness fixes).
summary.outcome: Confirmed the tracking commit (7984d2bea) landed despite the 2-min timeout; Wave 4 marked done with the depth-3 engine bug fixed and verified (6/6 e2e); plan 11 dispatched as a sequential agent to fix FUSE fail-closed gate issues (D-15a/b/c) directly on the phase branch, with cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse verification pending.

repo: lint-staged hooks on a large ROADMAP.md can make commit steps run long enough to hit a 2-minute tool timeout even though the commit succeeds.
The fuse crate build is left warm on disk after plan 09 runs, so running plan 11 sequentially on the main checkout is faster than spinning up a cold worktree for it.
workflow: When a commit step times out, verify with `git log` that the commit actually landed before retrying — don't blind-retry, per established guidance (feedback-gsd-commit-reword-verify-first).
Worktree isolation is reserved for plans that run concurrently; single, non-concurrent plans should execute sequentially on the main checkout to avoid unnecessary overhead.

friction: Commit step for the tracking commit hit the 2-minute timeout, requiring manual verification instead of trusting the tool's failure signal.
